knownDivergences.smithBehavior: emit skill:// URIs; contract test uses shape assertions instead of full schema validation; doctor's `kiro-cli agent validate` shell-out is the runtime ground truth

emit empty object {} when the bundle declares mcpServers; combined with includeMcpJson:true to consume the user's global ~/.kiro/settings/mcp.json. Required so the agent can actually USE its declared MCP servers — without this pair, kiro's per-agent JSON sees zero servers.
emit true alongside mcpServers:{} when the bundle declares mcpServers. Mirrors AWS's SageMaker reference agent pattern.

notes: Schema additionalProperties: false at the top level rejects fields the runtime accepts (mcpServers, includeMcpJson, useLegacyMcpJson, keyboardShortcut, welcomeMessage, toolAliases, toolsSettings). Smith's kiro translator emits only schema-documented fields plus skill:// URIs, with one targeted exception: mcpServers (empty object) and includeMcpJson (true) are emitted together when a bundle declares mcpServers — see the divergence entries above. The drift check in scripts/check-drift.ts filters knownDivergences to avoid false positives.
